scope: Standing research gate, not a proof or new numerical scan. Minimal DH thresholds are not asserted.
coefficient_convention: ordinary mu_n; classical Jensen coefficients n! mu_n
window_convention: multiplicative cutoff C; additive support length log C

routes.target: FinitePF XiMomentCoeff r for every r
routes.dh_analogue: All ordered Toeplitz minors of ordinary normalized folded DH coefficients are nonnegative.
routes.arithmetic_property: For zeta, -zeta_prime/zeta has nonnegative von Mangoldt coefficients supported on prime powers.
routes.gap: No Euler-product-to-Schur sign inequality in the small-shift/large-rank corner is proved.

routes.target: Nonnegativity of the full Weil form on every compact support window
routes.dh_analogue: The conductor-5 odd-gamma full DH Weil form, with every log-derivative coefficient and no zeta pole block.
routes.arithmetic_property: Von Mangoldt sign and prime-power support, plus multiplicativity behind Euler-product family identities.
routes.gap: An arithmetic bound for the complete Schur energy remains absent. Modified arithmetic forms have no demonstrated zero side.

routes.target: Hyperbolicity of every classical Jensen polynomial built from n! * XiMomentCoeff n
routes.dh_analogue: The classical n! normalization of normalized folded DH coefficients, not the ordinary-coefficient diagnostic.
routes.arithmetic_property: A quantitative Euler-product estimate controlling the relevant Jensen or Schur functional would be required.
routes.gap: The off-line zero excludes the full classical criterion; no first failing degree/shift has been certified here. No new scan is authorized by this register.

routes.target: GreenUnitMassPairedBudget, Lean-proved equivalent to RH for the actual Xi model
routes.dh_analogue: Requires rebuilding the same operator domain, one fixed form, every-zero states and mass/defect identities for completed DH.
routes.arithmetic_property: An actual Euler-product bound on the same-form relative paired residual would be required.
routes.gap: The generic defect obstruction at an off-line state is known; a complete DH-domain instantiation has not been proved. Do not call it a certified DH Green-form failure.

routes.target: The manuscript phase hypothesis H_theta and a missing zeta-specific implication to critical-pair exclusion
routes.dh_analogue: Use H_prime/H on horizontal segments for the actual DH function; preserve the exact phase conventions.
routes.arithmetic_property: A zeta-specific Euler-product phase estimate, not functional-equation symmetry alone.
routes.gap: The corrected manuscript does not claim a Lean equivalence H_theta iff RH. The generic exp(i*z)*z*(z-1) counterexample already defeats the proposed endpoint-to-phase-crossing implication.
